newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Board of Investment signs nine investment agreements worth 1.5 billion rupees during past month in ventures ranging from a luxury housing project to designer clothing project.
President Chandrika Kumartunga stresses importance of luring youth back to farmlands in government's bid to prepare for global food shortage in year 2005.
Government gives greenlight for multinational venture to exploit vast phosphate deposit at Eppawela beginning early next year.
Indian Foreign Minister I.K. Gujral to visit Sri Lanka in January, Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar tells parliament.
Armed forces launch operation to clear areas near an eastern security forces camp overrun by separatist Tamil Tiger guerrillas on Wednesday.
Security to be tightened in Colombo and suburbs during forthcoming Christmas holiday season, police say.
Tamil Tigers destroy 27 naval vessels during past two years with bodies of 147 naval personnel on those vessels never found, Education Minister Richard Pathirana tells parliament.
